text: The table clearly illustrates a remarkable upward trend in the ownership of major durable household appliances per 100 households in China from 2014 to 2023.
Specifically, air conditioners witnessed the sharpest surge, nearly doubling from 75.2 units in 2014 to 145.9 units in 2023.
Meanwhile, washing machines and refrigerators also climbed steadily, rising from 83.7 and 85.5 to 98.2 and 103.4 respectively.
These figures vividly reflect the steady upgrading of Chinese residents' living standards.
A multitude of economic and technological factors account for this encouraging shift.
Chief among these factors is that sustained economic growth has substantially enhanced families' purchasing power, enabling ordinary households to afford modern appliances that bring greater comfort.
Equally important is that rapid technological innovation and fierce market competition have made it far more affordable to buy energy-saving products.
Not only do these durable goods free people from tedious housework, but they also propel domestic consumption and industrial upgrading.
Taking all these factors into account, residents' pursuit of high-quality life will continue to grow.
Only through continuous innovation and supportive economic policies can we sustain this prosperity and further enhance public well-being.
